# react-simple-keyboard

Version 3.8.296, MIT. Upstream: https://github.com/hodgef/react-simple-keyboard

Used only in the shortcut-row editor to render the visual keyboard. The Khor adapter supplies terminal key codes, platform labels, accessibility and existing design tokens. It neither captures global keystrokes nor sends bytes to a session. System-only keys remain disabled; terminal encoding stays in term-key-codec. No vendor stylesheet or icon family is imported.
